changelog.name: 0.6.2-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body:
First release on the LSPosed module repository.

- 7TV, BTTV, FFZ and Homies emotes and badges, emote autocomplete with pinning, a favorites bar (any emote, optionally per streamer), deleted messages, timestamps, highlights, blacklist, pronouns, auto-claim channel points, player gestures, sleep timer and hide options.
- No ad blocking, and nothing money related.

**Already using PurpleTV ReVive from GitHub?** This listing uses a new module ID. Uninstall the old `PurpleTV XP` / `PurpleXposed` module first, so the two are not both active. Your settings are kept, since they live inside the Twitch app.

changelog.name: 1.4.1-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. Sleep timer the PurpleTV way: a crescent moon button (on by default, purple while running), any time in hours and minutes, and it closes Twitch when time is up (or only pauses, if you prefer). Fixed: brightness and volume swipes no longer block the quality and speed menus, swipes work on the stream again, and PurpleTV's player buttons always match Twitch's size.

changelog.name: 1.4.0-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. New: presets for the video and audio filters (built-in looks plus your own, synced), and a switch on every effect and section to turn it off without losing its setting. Fixed over 80 bugs found in a large review, including a crash when reloading Following with moving video effects, a black area above a docked keyboard on the unfolded Galaxy Fold, emotes leaking between channels after a switch, and several settings sync and blacklist problems.

changelog.name: 1.3.1-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. Fix: favorite sub emotes no longer show as "not available in this chat" when Twitch could not fetch your emotes at startup; it now tries again, and each favorite's picture is shared with your synced settings.

changelog.name: 1.3.0-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. New: favorite groups (folders or tabs, with a name or an emote icon), hold and drag favorites into groups, to a new spot or onto a bin, and a favorites bar that can grow into rows. Settings sync now merges setting by setting, and tapping the chat box with the emote menu open brings up the keyboard. (The Bits crash fixed in this release only affected the ready-to-install Twitch, not LSPosed.)

changelog.name: 1.2.0-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. New: sync your PurpleTV settings across devices through one file in your Google Drive (no sign-in); pressing Send with the emote menu open now sends in one go; and a one-time tip points to the Deleted messages setting the first time a deleted message shows in chat.

changelog.name: 1.1.0-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. New: Dynamic light filters (exposure, gamma, contrast and black point) that follow the stream and fix washed-out or very dark scenes as they happen, each with a strength, target and reaction speed; a Texture slider next to Clarity; and a Reset button for each section of the video filters.

changelog.name: 1.0.0-twitch31.7.0
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.7.0 and 31.1.2; the module picks the right setup by itself. Other Twitch versions will likely break some features. New: Twitch 31.7.0 support, keeping the classic stream screen on phones so chat features keep working (setting: Use the classic stream screen). Fixes: emote menu backspace on 31.7.0, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes on the chat history shown when a channel opens, and emote and badge servers that time out at startup are asked again later.

changelog.name: 0.9.3-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). New: the emote popup in chat shows where a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote comes from (global or this channel's), who uploaded it, and links to its page on 7TV, BetterTTV or FrankerFaceZ.

changelog.name: 0.9.2-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). New: mod logs, a chat line saying who timed out, banned, unbanned or deleted a message, in channels you moderate. Fixed: the landscape chat width now stays, with a separate width for the expanded chat, and hiding chat fills the screen again. Settings that can never work were removed.

changelog.name: 0.9.1-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). New: a player stats button (quality, bitrate, delay behind live, buffer, dropped frames), Disable low latency, Turn off autoplay of the next video, and Do not clear chat when a moderator uses /clear.

changelog.name: 0.9.0-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). New: audio filters next to the video filters (volume boost, auto volume, compressor, limiter, voice clarity, rumble cut, bass and treble or a full 16-band equaliser), and an emote picker backspace that deletes a whole word or emote. Fixed: the raid card for raiders now catches real raids, raider pictures on Twitch's own raid card, and slow chat after switching channels on some phones.

changelog.name: 0.8.1-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Hotfix, built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). Fixed: the raid card was missing when you arrived in a channel with a raid, because Twitch moves raiders over after the card has gone by; the module now adds the same card once your chat joins. New: an update checker that shows what changed, with Skip this version, Later and Update (switch it off under Updates).

changelog.name: 0.8.0-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Built for Twitch 31.1.2 (chat features will likely break on Twitch 31.5 and newer). Fixes video stutter, most noticeable while the player controls showed. Video filters grow to over 35, grouped, with texture overlays (32 built-ins, your own picture or a colour) and Photoshop's 27 blend modes, moving bokeh and 11 animated glitch effects; the full set now also works on Android 8 to 12. Channel and global 7TV, BTTV and FFZ sections at the bottom of the emote picker. BTTV badges. Pinned messages Disabled or 30 sec., Hide Drops notices, VOD seek amounts, a live refresh button (on by default), Following page section hiding, and Show tips again.

changelog.name: 0.7.0-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: New video filters for lives and VODs: a button in the player controls opens brightness, contrast, clarity, texture, saturation and vibrance, each with a plain-words explanation and a tone range (shadows to highlights). Also: a switch to hide Twitch Stories on Home, and One Chat lurker (hides the message box of the fullscreen overlay chat).

changelog.name: 0.6.6-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Home now opens on the Following tab (on by default, under View). Hide Create (plus) button now also hides the plus at the top of the side rail in landscape. Clearer names for the Browse (search) and Create (plus) options.

changelog.name: 0.6.5-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: On a fresh install, the emote pictures you are looking at (suggestions, favorites bar) now load first instead of waiting behind thousands of others, and your own emotes keep their pictures across channel switches.

changelog.name: 0.6.4-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Links inside chat announcements can now be tapped (Twitch never made them tappable). The emote tap handler also passes everything it does not need on to Twitch instead of replacing Twitch's own touch handling.

changelog.name: 0.6.3-twitch31.1.2
changelog.body: Push notifications now work on patched builds: Firebase sign-up gets Twitch's official certificate fingerprint on that one request. Switch it off under PurpleTV settings, Dev, Fix push notifications. On the original Twitch app (LSPosed) nothing changes.

readme:
# PurpleTV ReVive

Third-party emotes, badges, pronouns and a pile of chat quality-of-life tweaks for the official Twitch app for Android. A continuation of the great work of PurpleTV and bttv-android.

**Scope:** Twitch (`tv.twitch.android.app`). Restart Twitch after enabling.

## Features

- **7TV, BetterTTV, FrankerFaceZ and Homies emotes** in chat, animated ones included, with each channel's own pictures.
- **Emote autocomplete:** start typing an emote name, no colon needed. Hold an emote to pin it to the top, or to add it to the favorites bar.
- **Favorites bar** at the top of the emote picker, optionally per streamer.
- **Third-party badges** (FFZ, Chatterino, DankChat, Chatsen, Homies) and **pronouns**.
- **Deleted messages** shown struck through or greyed, **timestamps** with seconds, **highlights**, **blacklist**, `/me` styling, username display style, vibrate on mention.
- **Auto-claim channel points**.
- **Player:** brightness and volume swipes, sleep timer, skip the external link warning.
- **Hide clutter:** hype train, leaderboards, chat header, Bits button, Follow/Subscribe, create button and more.

Settings: open Twitch's own **Settings** screen; **PurpleTV** is the first row.

## What it will never do

No ad blocking, and no money-related mods of any kind. Ads and subscriptions are how Twitch and its streamers get paid.

## Notes

- Passkey sign-in cannot work on a patched (LSPatch) build; use your password or the Google, Amazon or Apple buttons. LSPosed users are not affected.
- Any client modification is against Twitch's Terms of Service. Use at your own risk.

Source code, issues and a ready-to-install patched Twitch APK: https://github.com/alienware377/purpletv-revive
readmeZh:
# PurpleTV ReVive

Android 官方 Twitch 应用程序的第三方表情、徽章、代词和一堆聊天生活质量调整。 PurpleTV 和 bttv-android 伟大作品的延续。

**范围：** Twitch (`tv.twitch.android.app`)。启用后重新启动 Twitch。

## 特点

- **聊天中的 7TV、BetterTTV、FrankerFaceZ 和 Homies 表情**，包括动画表情，以及每个频道自己的图片。
- **表情自动完成：** 开始输入表情名称，无需冒号。按住表情可将其固定到顶部，或将其添加到收藏夹栏。
- **收藏夹栏**位于表情选择器顶部，每个流媒体都可以选择。
- **第三方徽章**（FFZ、Chatterino、DankChat、Chatsen、Homies）和**代词**。
- **已删除的消息**显示为删除线或灰色，**时间戳**秒，**突出显示**，**黑名单**，`/me`样式，用户名显示样式，提及时振动。
- **自动认领频道点**。
- **播放器：**亮度和音量滑动、睡眠计时器、跳过外部链接警告。
- **隐藏杂乱：**炒作列车、排行榜、聊天标题、Bits 按钮、关注/订阅、创建按钮等。

设置：打开 Twitch 自己的 **设置** 屏幕； **PurpleTV** 是第一排。

## 它永远不会做什么

没有广告拦截，也没有任何类型的与金钱相关的模组。广告和订阅是 Twitch 及其主播获得报酬的方式。

## 注释

- 密钥登录无法在已修补的 (LSPatch) 版本上运行；使用您的密码或 Google、Amazon 或 Apple 按钮。 LSPod 用户不受影响。
- 任何客户端修改均违反 Twitch 的服务条款。使用风险自负。

源代码、问题和可立即安装的已修补 Twitch APK：https://github.com/alienware377/purpletv-revive
